Geometry judgment s7.2: the dominant every-3-seconds act is HOLDING THE CHANNEL -> beam_channel (commit_val=channel corroborates); the dossier footprint is a stage-expanding cone ('flames spread wider close to you and spread longer directly in front') recorded as the alternative. Stage-ramp mechanism -> MOMENTUM_CASCADE: engine Layer-2 (verified t4_catalog_v2/layer2_dimensions) is ON_HIT stacking-capped(10) -> THRESHOLD_BURST -- the same build-stacks-then-burst shape as ramp-to-8-then-release-wave; stack cap 8-vs-10 and the 500%-wave magnitude are Layer-2-pinned territory (mapping never re-pins). persistent_condition_shape=tick-cost carries mana-per-tick channel economy (magnitude unattested, shape only per R-M4). ERA-DRIFT note: 8 stages / release wave / expanding cone are the MODERN gem's numbers (dossier verbatim); the 1.x/2.x-era gem ramped 3 stages with no release wave -- same channel-ramp MECHANISM, numbers era-drifted, mapped on mechanism.
